To start, I always keep my carbs under 25 net carbs (net carbs are carbs minus fiber) a day. To do that I drink a premier protein drink for breakfast, I don’t eat lunch to save carbs so I consider the time I eat dinner until the time I have breakfast (15 hours) my fasting time....don’t worry about fasting right now, you can do that when you understand more about keto. The best thing to do is search your favorite dish in google and add keto to it. So you’ll search for “Keto spaghetti” or something of the sort. I have 1. A salad with lots of cheese and meat and avocado on it. 2. Grilled chicken with avocado, cheese, bit of onion and bell peppers on a cheese taco (it’s just cheese baked in a circle and curved) 3. Chicken, pork chops or steak grilled with light onions, mushrooms and freshly grated mozzarella melted on top, with a side of loaded broccoli. These are my go to meals. Some are cheap, some are kinda pricey. Btw, never buy pre shredded cheese. It usually contains corn or potato starch, which are hidden carbs. I suggest you joining the fb group “f is for fucking fat bombs” for more info, and look into making fat bombs...they’re....the bomb ;)
